fields.title: 4. Measurement-Layer Filings Read Together — 5 Schedule 13Gs (2026-11-16) · 424B5 (2026-11-17)
fields.md:
The previous installment read the 13F but did not read the 5 Schedule 13Gs Berkshire filed the same day. A 13G gives ownership percentage — a field the 13F does not have.

| Issuer | 13G type | Berkshire aggregate shares (2026-09-30) | Ownership | Check against 13F 3Q share count |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bending Spoons | New | 20,689,655 | 6.4% | Match |
| Delta Air Lines | Amendment No. 2 | 64,450,000 | 9.8% | Match |
| Bank of America | Amendment No. 8 | 455,860,908 | 6.6% | Match |
| VeriSign | Amendment No. 6 | 5,922,136 | 6.6% | Match |
| Kroger | Amendment No. 2 | 35,000,000 | 5.9% | Match |

Sources: [Bending Spoons 13G](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526464218/xslSCHEDULE_13G_X02/primary_doc.xml) · [Delta](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526464189/xslSCHEDULE_13G_X02/primary_doc.xml) · [Bank of America](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526464211/xslSCHEDULE_13G_X02/primary_doc.xml) · [VeriSign](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526464219/xslSCHEDULE_13G_X02/primary_doc.xml) · [Kroger](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526464214/xslSCHEDULE_13G_X02/primary_doc.xml) — all signed 2026-11-16. The 13F check is against the [3Q information table](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526463399/60471.xml).

- **T5 (Bending Spoons)**: The 13G gives an ownership percentage of 6.4% as of 9/30 — the reporting persons are Buffett, Berkshire, National Indemnity, GEICO Corporation and GEICO (source: [13G](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526464218/xslSCHEDULE_13G_X02/primary_doc.xml)). Back-calculated shares outstanding are about 323 million (estimate — formula 20,689,655 ÷ 0.064; the percentage is a rounded value, so there is some error). However, T5 asks about settlement of the 'additional stake (about 4%)', and **this probe has never held the original ownership percentage from a primary source**, so it cannot determine whether 6.4% includes the additional portion — remains on hold; verification paths are the 4Q26 10-K and tier-1 press reports (judgment).
- **Delta 9.8%**: Just below the 10% threshold (source: [Delta 13G](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526464189/xslSCHEDULE_13G_X02/primary_doc.xml)). A position increased by 12.4% in 3Q (source: [2026-11-17 installment](2026-11-17-event.md), section 2). Above 10%, Berkshire would become an insider of Delta, with trades disclosed on an ongoing basis via Form 4 (description of the rule — judgment). Placed among the questions for the next installment.
- **424B5 (2026-11-17 EDGAR, document date 2026-11-13)**: Final prospectus supplement for yen-denominated notes — 5 tranches totaling ¥182.3 billion, underwriting fee ¥295 million, company proceeds ¥182.005 billion, settlement scheduled 2026-11-19, with use of proceeds specifying refinancing of ¥73.4 billion (0.955%, maturing 2026-11-27) and ¥23.0 billion (0.203%, maturing 2027-01-25) (source: [424B5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526465047/d86634d424b5.htm)). Same terms as the FWP (2026-11-13) — T8 stays confirmed as is; only the proceeds figure is added.
